title: Zephyrine and the Inventory
author: F. M. Nakamura
blurb: Edmund Fairweather, a bridge inspector measuring the marriage in expansion joints, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. But when a childhood home goes up for auction, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
